label: Fires at GO in the last ~10 trials, growing toward episode end; larger after unrewarded trials and when S2 is believed good.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * np.square(np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0)) ;; (phase == GO) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 90, 0) * belief_lo
terms: (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (ep_trial - 90) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (ep_trial - 90) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (ep_trial - 90) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_trial >= 90) * (ep_trial - 90)**2
explanation: Essentially a GO-only feature in the last decile of the episode (timing alone R^2 0.42). Beyond the decile mean, magnitude ramps up (roughly quadratically) with trials past 90, and the ramp is steeper when the previous trial was unrewarded and when the ideal observer believes S2 is good (negative belief_lo, which co-occurs with a2 choices). D1/D2 activity is negligible. Profile additive tables (no within-decile ramp) reach only 0.03; the gain comes from the ramp x history interactions. The free fit adds linear ramp terms and non-ramped late offsets for reward/belief (dev 0.59 vs short 0.48). Underpredicts peak values (~6) in end-of-episode runs of unrewarded a2 choices.
